# PICSELL

> PICSELL is a Ukrainian retail-execution platform for FMCG manufacturers and distributors: Vision AI shelf recognition, Sales Force Automation (SFA) for field teams, HoReCa Intelligence and competitive market monitoring — one mobile app for every field role plus web analytics. Site in Ukrainian (https://picsell.ai/) and English (https://picsell.ai/en/). Part of Imperia Holding, Kyiv, Ukraine.

Key facts:
- Who it is for: FMCG brands (manufacturers) and distributors running merchandisers, sales reps and supervisors in retail stores and HoReCa (restaurants, bars, cafés).
- What it does: GPS-verified routes and visits, tasks with photo reports, Store Check and Perfect Store, assortment matrices, price monitoring, orders, KPI tracking, offline-first mobile app; Vision AI recognises products on shelf photos (out-of-stock, share of shelf, planogram compliance) in about 60 seconds per audit.
- Clients include Lactalis, Henkel, Schwarzkopf, Diageo, Colgate, Bayadera, Masafi and IDS Borjomi (see the Lactalis case study).
- Pricing (per user per month, UAH; final price agreed individually): merchandiser ₴1,400, sales rep ₴1,400, supervisor ₴1,000, other user ₴900. Radar and HoReCa add-ons from ₴20,000. Calculator: https://picsell.ai/en/calculator/
- Contacts: sales +380 77 880 98 88, support +380 67 363 06 44, info@picsell.ai. Free demo on request: https://picsell.ai/en/demo/

## Product
- [Core — field execution foundation](https://picsell.ai/en/core/): routes and visits with GPS, photo-report tasks, Store Check, Perfect Store, assortment and price monitoring, merch planning
- [Vision AI — shelf recognition](https://picsell.ai/en/vision-ai/): OOS detection, share of shelf, planogram compliance
- [SFA — field sales app](https://picsell.ai/en/sales-app/): route planning, orders, visit control, KPIs for sales reps
- [HoReCa Intelligence](https://picsell.ai/en/horeca/): brand presence in restaurant and bar menus, menu audits
- [Radar — competitive intelligence](https://picsell.ai/en/radar/): competitor prices and activity across channels
- [Analytics](https://picsell.ai/en/analytics/): BI dashboards, Perfect Store score, distributor KPIs
